source: Information Practices Act of 1977, Stats. 1977, Ch. 709 (SB 1983)
wound_addressed: No California statute governing state agency collection, use, or disclosure of personal information; no access, amendment, or remedy rights for citizens harmed by false state agency records
design_departure_from_federal: $200 floor without willfulness requirement (federal Privacy Act requires willfulness for $1,000 floor); §1798.53 individual employee liability (no federal analog)
